question: The Taj Mahal was built by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shah Jahan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shah Jahan** commissioned the construction of the Taj Mahal in 1632.
 
• The Taj Mahal was built as a mausoleum for his beloved wife, **Mumtaz Mahal**.
 
• It is located in **Agra, India**, and is one of the most famous and recognizable buildings in the world.
